verdict.rationale: Official ROCm docs list the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) by name on the PyTorch and JAX install pages. The Radeon ROCm support table covers 9000-series GPUs for PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX and ONNX on Linux and PyTorch on Windows, backed by a published compatibility matrix and documented vLLM/llama.cpp support. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these builds work on this card, and Windows support beyond PyTorch.
